160: function Dispatcher:UnregisterEvent(event, ownerOrID)
161: 	-- print("UnregisterEvent", event, ownerOrID)
162: 
163: 	if ((event ~= nil) and (self.Events[event] ~= nil) and (ownerOrID ~= nil)) then
164: 
165: 		-- First, Remove the callback
166: 		local callbackTable = self.Events[event];
167: 		local id = ownerOrID;
168: 
169: 		if (type(ownerOrID) == "table") then
170: 			id = self:FindKeyByValue(callbackTable, function(callbackData) return callbackData.Callback == ownerOrID; end);
171: 		end
172: 
173: 		if (id) then
174: 			callbackTable[id] = nil;
175: 		end
176: 
177: 		-- Second, Remove the event if no callbacks remain
178: 		local first = next(self.Events[event]);
179: 		if (first == nil) then
180: 			self.Events[event] = nil;
181:

183: 			if (event == "OnUpdate") then
184: 				self.EventFrame:SetScript("OnUpdate", nil);

188: end
